Scope: road works and the storm water drainage network for the support services area of the Second Industrial City in Makkah, Al-Akayshiyah. Contract value 33.04M SAR excluding VAT, 14 months from site handover.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. On 24-Nov-2026 the project is 61.5% complete against 53.4% planned, 8.1% ahead of plan. This week it gained 2.49% against 5.08% planned, about half the weekly plan, after 1.98% last week. No weekly report workbook was uploaded this week, so these figures are computed from the P6 update (UP 19) and the baseline programme.

Progress is still ahead of plan, but the weekly gain was again about half the plan and the forecast finish slipped 4 more days, to 62 days late. The P6 update (UP 19, data date 24-Nov-2026) schedules project completion on 25-Oct-2027, 62 days after the contract completion date of 24-Aug-2027, with −52 days of total float (−49 last week). The lead over plan narrowed from 10.7% to 8.1%. The purchase order for pavement markings is still not issued, and bituminous base has no delivery.

The P6 update (UP 19, data date 24-Nov-2026) has 381 activities: 205 completed, 44 in progress and 132 not started. Activities with negative float went from 122 to 113. This week P6 completed road excavation on Collector 02 and Local Road 10 and subgrade on Collector 02 and Local Roads 10, 11 and 28, and started aggregate base course on Collector 02 and Local Road 10 (both 90%) and Local Road 30 (60%). Pipe laying and backfilling on Local Road 29 were completed, and pipe installation started on Local Road 11 (40%).

Procurement of key materials

Procurement completion rate per material. Source: Procurement Log, weekly report 24-Nov-2026; purchase-order and delivery status also from the P6 update.

Pavement materials: aggregate base doubled, markings still without an orderAggregate base deliveries doubled to 10,000 m³ (38% of 26,167 m³) and kerbs rose to 2,553 m (10%), but P6 still shows the first aggregate base delivery at 0% with −52 days of float. Bituminous base has no delivery; its first stage is planned for 24-Nov-2026 to 03-Jan-2027 with −41 days. Interlock pavers stay at 3,000 m² (10%). Pavement markings still have no purchase order; P6 now plans it for 24 to 28-Nov-2026 with −34 days of float (−28 last week).
Storm drainage materialsGRP pipes (5,855 m), inlet manholes (82), catch basins (164) and traffic signs (171) are fully procured. P6 now also shows the second and third catch basin deliveries complete (18 and 21-Nov-2026).

Data notes

  • This week's upload has no weekly report workbook (sheets for progress, physical chart, quantities, milestones, manpower, HSE, quality, invoices and risks), no progress report PDF and no look-ahead workbook. Physical progress was computed from the P6 update and the baseline programme; the scope quantities, manpower and HSE sections are left out.
  • The summary files (works executed and progress files, Tracking Progress and the tracking presentation) label a cost-based figure as "actual" progress. This report uses physical (man-hour) progress only.
  • The tracking presentation gives the target completion date as 24-Aug-2027, while P6 forecasts 25-Oct-2027. It gives 35.92% of contract time elapsed, against 35.8% (day 152 of 425) from the handover date.
  • The tracking presentation says total disbursed is "none" (لا يوجد), while the 17-Nov-2026 invoice log shows three invoices paid (7,770,175 SAR).
  • The progress file and the works-executed file again show this week's progress with opposite signs. The works-executed file still gives a contract of 24-Nov-2025 to 23-May-2026, and names the MODON PM as الشنيفي instead of الجليفي.
  • The works list reports 1,200 m³ of subgrade on Local Road 31 this week, while P6 shows that activity finished on 16-Nov-2026. It reports 700 m³ of aggregate base on road 30, while P6 also shows aggregate base at 90% on Collector 02 and Local Road 10.
  • The works list reports 501 m of kerbs on roads 28 and 30, while P6 moves only the Local Road 28 kerb activity (12% to 30%).
  • The tracking presentation gives the cut quantity as "237,314222,090" m³ (two numbers run together) and fill as 183,569 m³, the same fill as in the last four weekly reports.
  • The Procurement Log shows 10,000 m³ of aggregate base delivered and three roads with aggregate base under way, while P6 still shows the first delivery at 0%. The log still gives "N/A" as the purchase-order date for aggregate base, bituminous base and kerbs; P6 shows the orders issued.
  • The Failed Start List lists 24 activities (numbered 2 to 131) and still carries the title and date (13-Oct-2026) of project MKH2-02-003; its variance column mixes 1, 6 and negative values without a stated unit.
  • P6 gives the storm water drainage milestone +10 days of float, although its forecast (02-Mar-2027) is 6 days after the baseline date.
  • The Risk and Issue Log is a blank template, identical to last week's file.
  • Week number: no file this week states the contract week. Last week's report stated contract week 21 for 17-Nov-2026, so 24-Nov-2026 is contract week 22; whole weeks from site handover give 21.
  • The site photos in the tracking presentation are GPS-stamped 08 and 09-Nov-2026, two weeks before the data date. Two of its eight photos share a caption (kerb installation on Local Road 11).
